headline: Indian Markets End Mixed as IT and Tata Stocks Drag Benchmarks
why: Rising US yields pressuring broad market P/E valuations globally.
Weakness in IT sector and select Tata Group stocks.
Concerns surrounding upcoming US Fed monetary policy decisions.
Crucial resistance and support retests amid volatile crude oil.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty posted their sixth consecutive week of losses.
Tata Group stocks remained in focus amid ongoing Tata Sons IPO buzz.
Paytm in spotlight for trading activity following recent market cues.
Three corporate stocks are set to go ex-date for stock splits next week.

stocksInNews.sources: Paytm in focus ahead of trading

summary: Indian equities traded mixed as weakness in IT majors and Tata Group shares capped gains. Sensex and Nifty face pressure from high US yields and crude oil movements, marking six straight weeks of losses. Investors remain cautious while tracking stock split actions and stock-specific triggers like Paytm.
